lower.basis: Lower flagstone court and well described by the Cyprus visitor guide and visible in the 2009 published Qualla view. Exact lower court bounds are estimated inside the mapped compound. The approximate inset ends on the observed rise of the western ground; the paved terrace elevation is based on unmodified GLO-30 samples and preserves well visibility.

campanile.plateauBasis: Independent source terrain at the western 1882 bell building.

museum.plateauBasis: Independent source terrain at the octagonal end of the western wing.
